description.en: Planned whole-organism study featuring small central disc merges into five long tapering angular arms.
description.zh: 拟议全体生物研究：小中央盘接五条长渐细角状腕。

scientific_scope.en: Provisional genus-level reconstruction proposal; the supplied source supports context or partial form, and detailed anatomy remains gated.
scientific_scope.zh: 暂定属级复原方案；来源支持背景或局部形态，详细解剖须通过参考审核。

distinctness.en: Its distinguishing construction is small central disc merges into five long tapering angular arms; retain this geometry rather than treating it as a recolor, scale or pose variant.
distinctness.zh: 以小中央盘接五条长渐细角状腕为独立造型依据；须保留这些结构差异，不能仅靠换色、缩放或姿势区别。

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly direction: establish small central disc merges into five long tapering angular arms in the blockout, then preserve the largest silhouette breaks and openings. Simplify fine ornament and repeated elements without copying reference meshes; palette and presentation are artistic choices, not fossil evidence.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形方向：先以小中央盘接五条长渐细角状腕搭建体块，再保留主要外轮廓转折与孔隙。细纹及重复结构可简化，不复制参考网格；配色与展示方式属于美术选择，并非化石证据。

uncertainty: Sources currently support the broader group or partial anatomy; the proposed genus-specific silhouette and period must be checked against an identified specimen or primary figure before production.
reference_notes: The era is a representative planning interval, not a full stratigraphic range or a coexistence claim. Verify the selected species, locality and specimen before a place-specific scene.

sources.title: Virtual Collection: Class Asteroidea - Digital Atlas of Ancient Life
sources.supports: Group-level shell/skeleton form and explicitly named fossil specimens only. Modern specimens on the same page do not establish prehistoric occurrence.
